posts.title: A Little Time Out Of My Day (Poetry Sidebar: Vol Eight)
posts.description: Feeling vulnerable (Then open up) Feeling… What? Just open up? What if we don’t know enough? (Then you’ll learn along the way) In the meantime it could fall apart I could disappoint What if it all ends so quickly? (Then you’ll start again) The last time I was broken I was empty I’m just… Afraid What if it is a cycle of repeated sadness (Then you finally accept sadness is human) What if I just stop

posts.description: This one is going to have three poems that I’ve previously put up other places, but have not found their way here.
